meta.note: 本文件为自动化落盘目标格式。当前环境无 Android 真机，四场景实测待主测中端机执行 flutter drive 后回填 measured 字段；nightly perf job 接入后自动覆盖。

primary.class: mid-range Android (Snapdragon 695/765 tier, e.g. Pixel 6a / Redmi Note 12)

toolchain.automation: flutter drive + integration_test Timeline (frame build/raster p95, dropped frame ratio)

scenarios.name: five_tabs_switch_x10_no_frame_spike
scenarios.budget: no sudden dropped-frame burst vs baseline

monitoring.nightly_perf_job: planned: record-only first release; escalate to CI gate after two consecutive releases regressing >10%
monitoring.escalation_rule: two consecutive versions with >10% regression -> gate

architecture_notes: standard quality (default) renders L1/L2 fill-only (zero BackdropFilter nodes) — S1/S2 cost dominated by content layer, glass overhead bounded by ForegroundDecoration single drawRect per panel (<0.1ms, <=8 panels)
ambient motion repaints only the L0 RepaintBoundary canvas via CustomPainter(repaint: controller); widget tree is not rebuilt during drift/pulse/breathe
saver quality disables all ambient motion and reduces overlay blur to sigma*0.6 — fallback if mid-range devices miss budgets
